# CREATOR-SYSTEMS — @charliehills 27 Things OS: one brain, four channels (DRAFT — v8)

Source: @charliehills "27 Things to Install in Claude for Socials" carousel,
COMPLETE 8/8, all in batch 19 (BULK-DECODE-LOG.md batch 19, items 10–17),
plus the standalone "The AI OS for LinkedIn System" cover (DfZr2esiDDu,
item 18). All silent, decoded from frames. Per-slide DECODE.md files:
research/video-harvest/instagram/charliehills_DfYK-*/.

## The rule
One brain runs it all. 27 things = 13 tools + 14 skills + 4 channels. Four
things feed every post: My rules (CLAUDE.md) / Memory (2,300+ notes) /
Notion (ideas + calendar, single source of truth) / Hermes in Slack (scores
research, chases jobs) — "EVERY CHANNEL READS IT". The human picks every
idea; Claude can suggest, it never decides. Every piece is scored before it
ships (see the 95-gate companion draft); under 95 it goes back.

## Executable steps (PWC adaptation — INFERRED mapping, his structure, Q's lanes)
1. One brain: Q's rules file (CLAUDE.md shape) + memory (every fix saved, so
   it never repeats — the notes-become-rules loop from the skill doctrine) +
   one calendar source of truth + one research scorer. Every channel reads
   all four.
2. Human decides every idea; Claude suggests, never decides. Q posts himself
   / approves via card — never a scheduler, never auto-post (his "I post it
   myself, from my phone. Native. No scheduler." is the same rule as Q's
   approval cards).
3. Per channel, six jobs in order (his pattern: find → make → voice-check →
   score → stage → human posts). Instagram lane for Q: find 5x outliers →
   watch why they worked → write the read word for word → cut/captions/
   motion in code → score (95-gate) → Q approves and posts.
4. Score every piece before it ships; under 95 goes back with the reasons
   fixed (95-gate companion draft).

## Worked example (PWC)
Q's four channels, his numbers: Instagram @yerrr__q (the only PWC promotion
lane — Kiya's rule: couples pages never promote PWC) / Skool Paid With
Content / Stan (CALENDAR $35, Kickstart $19.99) / ManyChat DM flows. One
brain: the PWC rules file + the notes file (every fix saved) + the launch
plan (Nov 2–Dec 6 waitlist build, Dec 7 cohort) + the outlier library. A
P-pack take runs the Instagram six: 5x outlier → why it worked → teleprompter
read → reel-edit → 95-gate → Q's approval card.

## Discrepancies — carried as observed, NOT reconciled
- **"17 FREE SKILLS" vs 14 named:** the CTA slide (08/08) offers "17 FREE
  SKILLS" but the carousel names 14 skills across its slides. Three skills
  are unnamed in the harvest. Recorded as observed, not reconciled.
- **Decision wording varies between two slides of the same carousel:** the
  cover (01/08) says "I pick the idea. Claude runs the rest."; slide 02/08
  says "I pick every idea. Claude can suggest. It never decides." Slight
  wording variation, same stance. Recorded as observed.
- **27 = 13 + 14, but the slide counts differ from the CTA count:** 13 tools
  + 14 skills = 27, matching the title; the CTA's "17 free skills" does not
  match either number. Recorded as observed.
